prompt: I want to build a simple puzzle and adventure game where the player (set in third person view, so you can see your avatar) will explore a world that has a forest setting, a mountain setting, and a water-based setting that are Zelda-inspired. The enemies should not move too much out of their set boundaries of land. There should also be weapons like swords and axes and bows and arrows you can pick up along the way on the ground or in other clever hidden areas of the world to help attack monsters that you encounter. There should be shops that are spread out evenly across the world that sell different types of healing or magic or weapon items. There should be occasional tokens and healing items also distributed around the world in locations where the player can access and destroy to get the items (like bushes, pots, barrels). The end goal of the game is to defeat the ultimate boss who is locked behind several different puzzles in a castle at the center of the map. The player starts out with 3 hearts and each hit by a monster should deplete half of a heart. Some of the harder puzzles should reward the player with an extra life heart. The maximum number of life hearts is 10. The puzzles can be something like manipulating blocks into a certain shape (with clues near the puzzle to indicate what the shape should be), running around an obstacle course in a specific sequence (with clues nearby), or a small arena that locks when you enter it and you have to defeat a set small number of monsters to win.
enriched: Build a 3D adventure game map featuring a large interconnected world divided into three distinct biomes: a dense forest area with tall trees and scattered clearings, a rugged mountain region with rocky cliffs and narrow paths, and a water-based zone with rivers, small lakes, and shorelines. Throughout the world, place simple puzzle zones such as block-manipulation puzzles near clues, obstacle courses with visible hints, and small locked arenas for combat challenges. Populate the landscape with gentle, goblin-like fantasy creatures patrolling limited territories within each biome, ensuring they stay within defined boundaries. Distribute weapons like swords, axes, and bows both visibly on the ground and cleverly hidden in natural props like bushes, pots, and barrels. Spread shops evenly across the map in small village-like clusters, each offering different healing, magic, or weapon items. Scatter collectible tokens and healing items in destructible environmental objects accessible to the player. The layout supports third-person exploration with clear sightlines to the avatar, varied terrain for traversal, and a balanced mix of open spaces and enclosed puzzle or combat zones leading toward the central castle boss area.

prompt:
Crea un juego completo de Roblox en 3D inspirado en la idea de "Escapa de Teclado", pero con mapas, mecánicas y modelos originales. No hagas un juego 2D. Debe ser una experiencia totalmente 3D con gráficos modernos y optimizada para PC y celular.

Concepto:
Los jugadores son personas miniatura atrapadas sobre un enorme escritorio. Deben escapar atravesando un teclado gigante mientras evitan obstáculos y peligros. El teclado debe sentirse enorme, con teclas gigantes que funcionan como plataformas.

Características:

- Mapa completamente 3D.
- Un teclado gigante como escenario principal.
- Varias zonas:
 - Teclas normales.
 - Teclas que desaparecen.
 - Teclas que rebotan.
 - Teclas que se hunden.
 - Zona del mouse.
 - Zona del monitor.
 - Zona de cables.
 - Zona del escritorio.
 - Zona de la CPU.
- Checkpoints automáticos.
- Sistema de guardado de progreso.
- Cronómetro para terminar el recorrido.
- Tabla de mejores tiempos (Leaderboard).
- Efectos de sonido al pisar teclas.
- Partículas en algunas zonas.
- Animaciones suaves.
- Música de fondo.
- Interfaz moderna.

Obstáculos:

- Láseres.
- Ventiladores.
- Teclas móviles.
- Plataformas giratorias.
- Cables eléctricos.
- Barras que empujan.
- Objetos que caen del escritorio.
- Zonas que eliminan al jugador.

Extras:

- Monedas coleccionables.
- Tienda de efectos cosméticos.
- Mascotas opcionales.
- Logros.
- Recompensas diarias.
- Sistema de niveles por experiencia.
- Botón para reiniciar desde el último checkpoint.

El estilo debe ser divertido, colorido y parecido a un obby moderno de Roblox, pero con identidad propia. Usa buenas prácticas, organiza correctamente el Explorer, separa Scripts, LocalScripts y ModuleScripts cuando sea necesario y evita código desordenado. El juego debe funcionar tanto en computadora como en dispositivos móviles.

Surrounding the keyboard are multiple themed zones progressing outward: a large mouse area with buttons and scroll wheel platforms; a monitor zone with ledges and screen edges to traverse; a tangled cable zone with twisting wires forming narrow paths; an open desktop surface scattered with office items; and a CPU area featuring mechanical elements and vents. The overall layout balances challenge and fun, designed for both PC and mobile play with optimized geometry and intuitive navigation.
